description.en: Sets the formation a match team lines up in. It is stored in the team's match setup, so it is meant to be called while the match is being set up (InitBtl).
Team: 0 = the player's team, 1 = the opponent team.
Formation ID, e.g. "ifb0301" (a 5-a-side formation), or its CRC32 hash as an integer.

true once the call has run.
null if the match system is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments were given.

examples.case: Forcing a formation for a 5-a-side story challenge (real usage, from btl0301.nut)
examples.code:
// The player's team plays this challenge in formation ifb0301
CMND_BTL_SET_FORMATIONID(0, "ifb0301");
